digest.headline: Platform and AI tooling, week 40
digest.intro: Three releases worth a look this week.

items.title: Marlowe Mesh supports multi-cluster failover
items.summary: Marlowe Mesh supports multi-cluster failover for internal services. Traffic moves to a healthy cluster when health checks fail.
items.whyItMatters: Traffic moves to a healthy cluster when health checks fail.

items.title: Pellam Flags adds scheduled rollouts
items.summary: Pellam Flags adds scheduled rollouts for feature flags. A rollout can raise exposure in steps and pause on an alert.
items.whyItMatters: A rollout can raise exposure in steps and pause on an alert.

items.title: Hollin DB lowers p99 read latency
items.summary: Hollin DB lowers p99 read latency from 80 ms to 60 ms on the reference workload. The gain comes from a new block cache.

sources.title: Marlowe Mesh supports multi-cluster failover
sources.summary: Marlowe Mesh supports multi-cluster failover for internal services. Traffic moves to a healthy cluster when health checks fail. Failover events are exported as metrics.

sources.title: Pellam Flags adds scheduled rollouts
sources.summary: Pellam Flags adds scheduled rollouts for feature flags. A rollout can raise exposure in steps and pause on an alert. Every change is recorded with the author and the time.

sources.title: Hollin DB lowers p99 read latency
sources.summary: Hollin DB lowers p99 read latency from 80 ms to 70 ms on the reference workload. The gain comes from a new block cache. Write latency is unchanged.
